info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to drip, to flow, to ooze out

examples: 'mahAvanamiva cCinnaM SiSye vigalitadrumam' (BA0 vi0 23.32). vigalitAH patitA drumA yatra tat.
'rativigalitabanDe keSapASe sukeSyAH' (vikrama0, raGu0 9.67, tatra priyAyA iti pAWaH).
'ratO niDuvane vigalitA viGawitA visrastA banDAH kabaryo yatra. jalAtpunarvigalito (matsyo) galito vakena' (paYcata0 2.87). vigalito BrazWaH, nizkrAnta iti yAvat. galito nigilitaH, avagIrRaH.
'kAmAgnineva santaptaH svinno vigalitaH sa ca' (kaTA0 18.78). ukto'rTaH.
'dAkziRyodakavAhinI vigalitA' (mfcCa0). vigalitA niHSezeRa srutA syannA skannA SozaM gatetyarTaH.
